title: Audit export CSV: values starting with = + - or @ go out unneutralised, so a spreadsheet can read them as formulas (gate 202 N4)
description:
**BLUF:** The admin audit export (`GET /api/admin/audit/export`) writes CSV through `escapeCSVField`, which quotes a value only when it contains a comma, a double quote or a newline. A value that starts with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` therefore goes out raw, or quoted only by accident, and a spreadsheet can read it as a formula. Gate 202 measured this on PR 2012 (KS-1645) at base and at head and graded it a Note; no ticket carries it. Whether any consumer opens the export in a spreadsheet is not known.

## What the gate measured (gate 202 on PR 2012, finding N4; its G-CSV cells, base and head)

* `escapeCSVField` (`services/api-gateway/src/routes/audit-export.ts`, lines 90 to 97, unchanged by the PR) quotes only values containing a comma, a double quote or a newline.
* `+1+1`, `-2` and `@SUM(A1)` go out raw.
* `=HYPERLINK(...)` is quoted only because it contains a comma, and it still starts with `=`.
* A bare carriage return is not quoted, at base or at head.
* `userAgent` and `ipAddress` can be set by the caller and were populated at base too. PR 2012 newly fills `action`, `resource` and `timestamp`, which the service sets.
* The gate's grading: a Note, not a hold, "per the commission".

## What is NOT known

* Whether any consumer opens the export in a spreadsheet.
* Whether a caller-controlled value can reach the export with a leading formula character in practice. The rows above are the writer's outputs for the listed strings; the seat filing this read the verdict and ran nothing.

## Owed

Decide the writer's contract for values that start with a formula character, and add a cell that fails when one goes out unneutralised.

## Searched before filing (2026-11-06, includeArchived, titles, descriptions and comments)

* "escapeCSVField": 0 issues, 0 comments. "CSV injection": 0 and 0. "formula injection": 0 issues and 1 comment, which is KS-1645's own close comment saying it found no ticket for N4.
* Controls in the same session: "KS-1539" hit, a nonsense symbol returned 0.

Related: KS-1645 (the export fix, Done) and KS-2013 to KS-2016 (gate 202's other findings, filed).
Source: the gate 202 verdict in Wednesday's reference folder (2026-11-05_gate202-ks1645-pr2012), N4. Filed on Wednesday's ANSWER of 2026-11-06 06:43Z, priority Medium.
